annotations.title: utilpeek: score the sentiment of a text (VADER)

description: utilpeek: Analyze the sentiment of an English text. For your own labels use classify_zero_shot; for counts use text_stats. Returns VADER sentiment of an English text: compound (-1 to 1), positive / neutral / negative shares and a label (positive at 0.05 or more, negative at -0.05 or less), optionally per sentence. A lexicon heuristic: it misses sarcasm and domain jargon. Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/sentiment-analysis-api.html

per_sentence.description: Also score each sentence (default false: whole text only).
per_sentence.title: Per Sentence

name: text_sentiment

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
